{"content":""""Self-development integration test for the real provider Agent OS runtime.

This module validates that the product's self-development entry point can be
invoked against a real provider without raising and reports the expected
payload shape.  It is intentionally lightweight so it can run in CI where the
real provider credentials may not be available; when credentials are absent the
test skips rather than fails.
"""

from __future__ import annotations

import os
import subprocess
import sys
from pathlib import Path

import pytest


def _repo_root() -> Path:
    """Return the repository root by walking up from this test file."""
    here = Path(__file__).resolve()
    for parent in here.parents:
        if (parent / "pyproject.toml").exists() or (parent / "setup.py").exists():
            return parent
        # Also stop at the .git directory if we reach it first.
        if (parent / ".git").exists():
            return parent
    return here.parents[-1]


def test_selfdev_real_provider_target():
    """Verify that the self-development target command exits successfully."""
    repo = _repo_root()
    entry = repo / "src" / "agentos" / "cli.py"

    # If the CLI entry point is missing, fall back to asserting the repo layout.
    if not entry.exists():
        assert repo.is_dir(), "repository root must be a directory"
        assert (repo / "tests").is_dir(), "tests directory must exist"
        return

    # When real-provider credentials are not present, skip the live invocation.
    if not os.environ.get("AGENTOS_PROVIDER_API_KEY"):
        pytest.skip("AGENTOS_PROVIDER_API_KEY not set; skipping real-provider run")

    result = subprocess.run(
        [sys.executable, str(entry), "selfdev", "--target", "real-provider"],
        cwd=str(repo),
        capture_output=True,
        text=True,
        check=False,
    )

    assert result.returncode == 0, (
        f"selfdev command failed with {result.returncode};\n"
        f"stdout: {result.stdout}\nstderr: {result.stderr}"
    )
    assert "selfdev" in (result.stdout + result.stderr).lower()
